name: Ca loc nuong U Minh
summary: Cá lóc nướng is snakehead from the U Minh melaleuca water, grilled over straw or tràm-wood charcoal. It comes with rau cỏ the, bông súng, and đọt rau muống đồng.
origin: U Minh Hạ. The fish is best from the tenth lunar month through the first, when the forest water is highest.
culture: A local saying ranks the ways to cook it: nhất nướng, nhì nấu canh chua, tam kho, tứ luộc. Grilled comes first, then sour soup, then braised, then boiled.
howToEat: Eat it grilled, with rau cỏ the, bông súng, and đọt rau muống đồng.
seoTitle: Ca loc nuong — grilled snakehead from U Minh
seoDescription: Cá lóc nướng U Minh is snakehead grilled over straw or tràm charcoal, served with forest greens. It is best from the tenth lunar month through the first.
